comment: src/Integrator.cpp at commit b90cd69. The delta jacks are monophonic: getVoltage() is called with no channel argument. The reset input uses a default SchmittTrigger straight on the jack voltage, so it rises at 1V and falls at 0V. The delta range given here is the useful one rather than a clamp: any voltage is accepted and simply multiplied by the speed trimpot. The module is both a DMA client and a DMA host, which is unusual: DMAExpanderModule takes its host from the module on its right (DMA.hpp line 267), while getDMAChannel at line 190 hands its own channel out first and then passes the host's channels through, which is how stacking works. Its own channel is two cells tall; when the host's first channel is also two rows tall it is widened rather than inserted, so the two appear as one memory.
